description:
Add a step to a workflow and connect it into the run. Only stores it: nothing executes until the workflow runs. Appends by default; `sort_order` splices it in at a position. In a run, run_checklist drives a real browser; notification emails or messages members on Slack; github_comment and actor_pr_review post on the triggering pull request; crawl_topology crawls a topology in a real browser to make a new version of its map; condition and delay only steer or pause. Config per step type:

run_checklist: { checklist_id, use_deployment_url? } runs a checklist and passes its pass/fail counts to the next step.
condition: { field, operator, value } continues down its True branch when it holds and ends the run otherwise. `field` is 'previous_step.status', another 'previous_step.<key>' off the last step's output, or 'trigger.<key>' off the event that started the run. `operator` is eq, neq, gt or lt.
notification: { channel, recipients, template, subject?, body?, slack_channel_id? }. channel is 'email' or 'slack'; recipients is { type: 'all_members' } or { type: 'members', member_ids: [...] }; template is 'completed', 'failed' or 'custom' (custom uses subject and body).
delay: { duration_seconds } waits before the next step. Waits are checkpointed, so a long one is free.
github_comment: { body_template } comments on the pull request that triggered the run (GitHub App or Cursor Origin, depending on the trigger). The template may use {{passed}}, {{failed}} and {{summary}}.
actor_pr_review: { actor_id, review_focus? } has an actor review the triggering pull request.
crawl_topology: { topology_id } crawls a topology again and passes the new version's status, page count and what changed since the last version (added, changed, removed) to the next step.

checklist_id.description: Checklist to run, from the same workspace.

use_deployment_url.description: Run against the deployment URL from the triggering event instead of the checklist URL.

anyOf.description: Config for condition. Continues down its true branch when it holds.

value.description: Value the field is compared with.

anyOf.description: Config for notification: sends an email or Slack message to workspace members.

body.description: Message body for the custom template.

recipients.description: Email recipients. Defaults to every workspace member.

slack_channel_id.description: Slack channel for a Slack message.

subject.description: Email subject for the custom template.

template.description: Message template. 'custom' uses subject and body.

anyOf.description: Config for github_comment: comments on the triggering pull request.
Config for actor_pr_review: an actor reviews the triggering pull request.

actor_id.description: Actor that reviews, from the same workspace.

review_focus.description: What the review should concentrate on.

anyOf.description: Config for crawl_topology: crawls the topology again to make a new version.

topology_id.description: Topology to crawl, from the same workspace.

config.description: Step configuration: the shape matching step_type. Any checklist, actor, topology or other id named here must belong to the same workspace.

sort_order.description: Zero-based position to insert at. Defaults to the end. Steps already at or after it move down.

step_type.description: What the step does: run_checklist, condition, notification, delay, github_comment, actor_pr_review, crawl_topology. Decides which config shape applies (see the description).

workflow_id.description: Automation (workflow) UUID, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: add_workflow_step

connected.description: True once the step is wired into the run.

id.description: The new step UUID, the step_id the step tools take.

title: Add workflow step
